record.situation_before: A security workstream and an implementation workstream are both active, but the implementation ETA belongs to the implementation owner.
record.trigger: The latest open loop asks for implementation status or ETA on a fix owned by a named implementation team.
record.ic_action: Ask the implementation owner for status, ETA, and blocker; do not ask the security owner for implementation delivery.
record.why_it_worked: It keeps the ask aligned to the owner of the open workstream while preserving security as the owner for rotation or audit tasks.

use_when: current evidence separates security work from implementation work
open loop is implementation status or ETA
required_current_evidence: implementation owner named in current evidence
implementation fix or validation task named in current evidence
